summary: Convert a Roman numeral string to an integer.
mainInsight: Scan left to right; add each symbol's value, but if a symbol is smaller than the next one, subtract it instead (IV = 5 - 1). A dict maps the seven symbols to values.

approaches.name: Subtractive pairs lookup
approaches.summary: Check two-character tokens (IV, IX, XL, ...) first.

approaches.name: Compare with next symbol
approaches.summary: Add the value, or subtract it when it is less than the next symbol's value.
weaknesses: Needs a bounds check on the last symbol

commonMistakes: Indexing past the end when looking ahead
Adding the subtractive symbol and the larger one separately
Using a wrong value for one of the symbols
edgeCases: Four-like numerals such as IV, IX

promptVariants: How do you handle subtractive notation such as IV and CM when parsing?
What rule decides whether a symbol is added or subtracted?
options: Subtract a symbol when it is smaller than the symbol after it, otherwise add it
Subtract every symbol that appears before a vowel-like letter
Always add, then subtract 2 for each pair of equal symbols
Process right to left and only subtract the symbol 'I'
cards.answer: Subtract a symbol when it is smaller than the symbol after it, otherwise add it
cards.explanation: In IV, I < V so I counts as -1 and V as +5.

incorrectOptionExplanations.Subtract every symbol that appears befor: Roman numerals have no vowels rule.
incorrectOptionExplanations.Process right to left and only subtract: X and C subtract too (XL, CM).

promptVariants: Why does 'subtract if smaller than next' work for all valid numerals?
cards.answer: In valid Roman numerals a smaller symbol directly before a larger one is always part of a subtractive pair (I before V/X, X before L/C, C before D/M), meaning it contributes negatively. All other symbols contribute positively, so one pass with a look-ahead gives the value.
keyPoints: Only I, X, C are subtractive
cards.explanation: Equivalent to scanning right to left with a 'previous' value.

promptVariants: Complete the statement: Space complexity (excluding the input): ___
How are its subtractive pairs resolved?

incorrectOptionExplanations.1894, treating C as subtractive twice: Only a smaller symbol before a larger one subtracts.
